title: NOAA Fisheries: Kemp's ridley turtle
supports: Distribution, April–July nesting and daytime arribadas.

title: Australian Government DCCEEW: Flatback turtle
supports: Distribution, Australian breeding sites and soft-bottom habitats.

title: Queensland Government: Sea turtle nesting areas mapping
supports: Regional nesting calendars; based on Marine Turtle Breeding and Migration Atlas Project (2021). Nesting months are not migration dates.

title: Hays et al. (2000): The diving behaviour of green turtles at Ascension Island
supports: Six inter-nesting females; routine resting dive depths of 18–20 m. Surface-to-20 m band in species.json is an editorial summary.

title: Iverson et al. (2019): Loggerhead sea turtle diving changes with productivity, behavioral mode, and sea surface temperature
supports: 26 adult female tracks, northern Gulf of Mexico; approximately 80% of time at 0–30 m; study maximum 160 m.

title: Witt et al. (2011): Tracking leatherback turtles from the world's largest rookery
supports: Gabon post-nesting dispersal; predominantly surface–200 m; maximum recorded 1080 m. No coordinates extracted from figures.

title: Gaos et al. (2012): Dive behaviour of adult hawksbills in the eastern Pacific Ocean
supports: Study-specific shallow depth use, mostly within 10 m; not a universal species limit.

title: Sasso and Witzell (2006): Diving behaviour of an immature Kemp's ridley turtle from Gullivan Bay
supports: Single immature turtle; normal bottom-associated behaviour in 2–3 m water. Not a population estimate.

title: McMahon et al. (2007): Satellite tracking reveals unusual diving characteristics for the olive ridley turtle
supports: Northern Australia; individual mean maximum depths 20.1–46.7 m; recorded maximum 200 ± 20 m. Means and dive ranges are different statistics.

title: Sperling et al. (2010): Diving behaviour in two distinct populations of gravid Flatback turtles
supports: Inter-nesting TDR study: maximum 29 m at Curtis Island, 44 m at Bare Sand Island.

title: SWOT: Online Map & Sea Turtle Database
supports: Discovery source only. Nesting and telemetry records hosted at OBIS-SEAMAP; data reuse subject to SWOT terms and requests. No raw tracks downloaded.

title: OBIS: Access OBIS data
supports: Occurrence access and field definitions. Bathymetry is seabed depth, not measured turtle depth. No raw records downloaded in this session.

title: NOAA InPort: Kemps Ridley and Loggerhead Tracking data in GOM
supports: Potential actual telemetry source for two species. Catalog inspected; files not downloaded.
